detail: Official Hillingdon Heritage Assets service exposes Listed Buildings layer 43 as esriGeometryPoint. Point/centroid evidence is not a building footprint and cannot satisfy DIRECT_BUILDING_PRESENT or Height Difference parcel acceptance. The service coverage extent is retained only as AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 coverage geometry. No canonical parcel, footprint, elevation pixel, or zonal statistic fabricated.
